projects.title: Chocolate sales dashboard
projects.summary: Interactive Streamlit dashboard for analyzing chocolate sales by country, product, and salesperson.
projects.detail: Loads chocolate-sales CSV data, removes missing and duplicate rows, normalizes amount and date fields, and provides filters with line, bar, pie, and table views.

projects.title: GDP dashboard
projects.summary: Streamlit dashboard for browsing GDP data for countries around the world over time.
projects.detail: Loads World Bank GDP data from CSV, reshapes yearly columns into year/value records, filters countries and years, and presents time-series charts and country metrics.

projects.title: Open API weather explorer
projects.summary: HTML, CSS, and JavaScript weather app that uses Open-Meteo geocoding and forecast APIs.
projects.detail: Accepts a city, resolves its coordinates through Open-Meteo geocoding, requests current weather, displays Fahrenheit temperature, and maps weather codes to visual conditions.

projects.title: Portfolio website & AI prototype
projects.summary: React and TypeScript portfolio with a separately developed Flask/Ollama RAG prototype. The assistant is not enabled on the public site.
projects.detail: A separate, not-yet-deployed RAG prototype retrieves reviewed portfolio evidence with FAISS and all-MiniLM-L6-v2 and uses qwen2.5:7b for grounded answers. This public portfolio release does not offer an AI chat interface.

projects.title: World Happiness Analytics Pipeline
projects.summary: An end-to-end analytics pipeline using Prefect to automate World Happiness Report data processing and statistical analysis.
projects.detail: Automates multi-year data ingestion, validation, cleaning, transformation, hypothesis testing, correlation analysis, and visualization to explore global happiness trends.

projects.title: WHO life expectancy analysis
projects.summary: Streamlit-based exploration of WHO life expectancy data, health indicators, and country-level trends.
projects.detail: Cleans missing values with mean and median imputation, engineers health and economic features, and uses exploratory plots to examine factors related to life expectancy.

projects.title: MLB history scraping & dashboard
projects.summary: Python data pipeline that collects historical baseball statistics and presents them in an interactive Streamlit dashboard.
projects.detail: Extracts historical player and league statistics from Baseball Almanac, imports structured records into SQLite, and offers filters and charts for MLB seasons and players.

projects.title: Student grade prediction
projects.summary: Exploratory analysis and regression models to understand and predict final student math grades.
projects.detail: Analyzes academic and demographic factors, handles students who did not take the final exam, and compares baseline and feature-rich linear regression models using RMSE and R².

projects.title: Spam classifier comparison
projects.summary: Machine learning study comparing several classifiers on the UCI Spambase email dataset.
projects.detail: Benchmarks KNN, decision trees, random forests, and logistic regression with scaling, PCA, five-fold cross-validation, and precision, recall, and F1 evaluation.

projects.title: Image classification with PyTorch
projects.summary: Comparison of pretrained CNNs on six outdoor scene categories, including inference speed and transfer learning.
projects.detail: Evaluates ResNet18, MobileNetV3-Small, and EfficientNet-B0 using confidence and latency analysis, PCA feature visualization, and a fine-tuned classification head.
